charte.title: “Diaspora sand” charter
charte.heading: Diaspora sand
charte.lead: DIASPORALE's components, mounted with fictitious data, to review and accept the interface in both themes.

color.title: Colour
color.lead: Six named colours, a single warm hue per theme, barely saturated: nothing turns beige or brown. In light mode, sand cards sit on a paper background; in dark mode, lighter cards sit on the night background.

contrast.title: Contrast
contrast.lead: Measured live on this page, in the theme shown. Text holds at least 4.5:1 and main text stays between 12 and 16:1, strong without glare; field outlines and the focus ring hold 3:1.

type.title: Typography
type.lead: IBM Plex in three widths: character comes from width, not from a foreign typeface. One Condensed heading per screen; subheadings in Plex Sans.

shape.title: Geometry
shape.lead: Tight radii, with a single exception: the pill, kept for what you toggle or scroll.

tag.title: Country tag
tag.lead: The signature: the tag you hang on a suitcase. The country is the permanent context; at the top of a hub, its code becomes monumental.

trust.title: Trust
trust.lead: Four badges, never confused, always with an icon and a label. “Official” is an ink stamp.

notices.title: Floating cards
notices.lead: Notices pass in front of the page: a card without outline, the tone carried by the dot alone, a cross to dismiss it. The demonstration keeps a permanent marker in the header.

cards.title: Cards
cards.lead: Sand cards on a paper background in light, lighter cards on a night background in dark: surfaces are separated by lightness, without an outline. Every piece of content carries its country.

controls.title: Controls
controls.lead: Pills to toggle, buttons to act. A choice reads without an outline: the chosen pill turns to ink, the chosen option takes the selection tint, lighter than the card in dark mode. One primary button per area; 44-pixel targets.
